    {
      "keystrokes": "cd /app && python3 -c "
import math, subprocess, random
def fib(n):
    a,b=0,1
    for _ in range(n): a,b=b,a+b
    return a&0xffffffff
random.seed(42)
fail = 0
for i in range(100):
    n = random.randint(0, 2**32-1)
    expected = fib(math.isqrt(n))
    result = subprocess.run(['./sim', str(n)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    got = int(result.stdout.strip()) if result.stdout.strip() else -1
    if got != expected:
        print(f'FAIL N={n} isqrt={math.isqrt(n)} expected={expected} got={got}')
        fail += 1
print(f'Random tests: {100-fail}/100 passed')
"
",
      "duration": 60.0
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "wc -l /app/gates.txt && head -5 /app/gates.txt && echo '---' && tail -5 /app/gates.txt && echo '---format check---' && python3 -c "
import re
pat = re.compile(r'^out\d+ = (0|1|out\d+|~out\d+|out\d+ [&|^] out\d+)$')
bad = 0
for line in open('/app/gates.txt'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    if not pat.match(line):
        print('BAD:', repr(line))
        bad += 1
print(f'Format check: {bad} bad lines')
"
